meta.name: MandateLab Security Runbook
meta.description: A matte-black, evidence-first interface for adversarial testing of autonomous financial authority on Monad.

primary.role: Monad identity, active controls, and runtime authority

accent.role: Policy hashes, run metadata, and focused states

neutral.usage: Near-black page and report surfaces with warm gray secondary text and off-white primary text

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast warm text on matte black; purple is reserved for Monad/runtime state, red for injected mutations, and green for killed mutations

typography.font_style_notes: Humanist geometric sans for decisive editorial hierarchy; restrained monospace for policy commitments, reason codes, counters, and calldata

spacing.section_rhythm: Large 84-116px section intervals interrupted by compact 42-62px evidence rows

layout.grid_system: Asymmetric 12-column editorial grid with nested evidence ledgers
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with asymmetric hero and left-aligned evidence

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px rules define report surfaces, rows, and authority boundaries
shape.divider_style: Hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.13) with stronger 0.23 separators at major boundaries

elevation.shadow_style: Near-flat with one hard offset purple-tinted proof-console shadow
elevation.depth_cues: Surface tone, hairline borders, and a single offset shadow rather than blur or glass

iconography.style: Technical construction-line symbols with a fractured authority seal
iconography.preferred_set: Custom MandateLab mark plus minimal line icons only when a text label is insufficient

motion.entrance_pattern: Mutation rows appear in sequence after a run with no page-scale theatrics
motion.exit_pattern: Immediate state replacement with a short opacity fade
motion.philosophy: Minimal functional motion that exposes state change and respects prefers-reduced-motion

components.button_style: Square 3px-radius controls; one solid Monad-violet primary and bordered secondary actions
components.input_style: Dark report-field surfaces with 1px borders, visible focus rings, and monospace values
components.card_style: Evidence panels and ledgers, not floating marketing cards; flat surfaces divided into rows
components.navigation_pattern: Compact horizontal brand/navigation/status bar with direct anchor links
components.modal_style: Avoid modals for core proof; use inline state and wallet feedback
components.list_style: Numbered runbook rows with reason codes aligned at the far edge
components.component_notes: Tables, tab panels, policy definition lists, and run ledgers carry the product proof; decorative feature grids are intentionally excluded

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A security runbook and mutation-test report open beside an onchain authority boundary
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary developer tooling filtered through 1980s technical manuals and editorial specimen sheets

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous around claims, compact inside run data
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Heavy left editorial headline balanced by dense right-side proof console
visual_language.focal_strategy: The live five-attack report is the primary proof; all later sections explain its mechanism and boundary
visual_language.texture_usage: No decorative texture; hierarchy comes from rules, type weight, and semantic color

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale contrast plus spatial isolation, followed by ledger density
composition.flow_direction: Hero claim to live report, then policy fixture, concurrency mechanism, Monad fit, and deployment limits
composition.grouping_strategy: Evidence grouped by shared authority question rather than generic feature category
composition.negative_space_role: Creates confidence around the major claim and prevents diagnostic data from feeling noisy

imagery.photo_treatment: No photography in the application surface
imagery.illustration_style: Generated technical-plate authority seal used only in social and submission header art
imagery.graphic_elements: Policy hashes, reason codes, status rules, numbered mutation rows, and a fractured seal mark
imagery.image_shape: Asymmetrically cropped wide header art; compact square logo mark

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate and explicit with run numbers, killed counts, reason codes, and selected mutation traces
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Hairline border or text-color change without lift, glow, or scale
interaction_feel.loading_style: Prefer truthful pending labels and inline progress over skeleton-card theatre

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Forensic, plainspoken, and willing to state what remains unproven
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct imperative such as Run 5 attacks
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain the missing evidence and the exact action or event needed to produce it
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific reason code plus a short causal explanation; never vague reassurance

overview.fallback_strategy: Disable entrance motion and preserve every proof state as static HTML under prefers-reduced-motion

background_effects.description: A flat matte-black field intentionally replaces gradients, ambient blobs, and decorative noise

particle_systems.description: Particle systems are excluded to keep the proof surface literal

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements; the product proof remains a two-dimensional report

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll morphing; document flow remains stable and inspectable

text_effects.description: Typography relies on editorial scale and semantic color rather than animated text

cursor_effects.description: The system cursor is preserved for usability

image_effects.description: Brand imagery is static and never competes with the interactive proof

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas drawing is needed for the deterministic runbook

svg_animations.description: The logo is static; no decorative path animation is used

visual_effects.composite_notes: The only visual flourish is a hard violet-tinted offset behind the proof console. All other hierarchy is produced by type, rules, and semantic status colors so the interface remains fast, legible, and credible on low-power devices.
